text:
maria: Quick brainstorm 1001 1: Could we build a single waterfall chart that stacks latency buckets (p50/p95/p99) for each model config and overlays unit cost ($/1k tokens)? I want 1 hero slide for the webinar and a simplified static for the blog/social.

alex: Yes. waterfall + cost overlay = concise. can we show hosted vs dedicated side-by-side? enterprise always asks that. :eyes: 

maria: Good call. show hosted (fleet avg) and dedicated (reserved) across three model families: redwood-small, redwood-med, open-xl. annotate where caching and batching affect both latency and cost.

sam: For axes: left Y = latency (ms), right Y = $/1k tokens. X axis = model+config (e.g., rs-small | quant | cached). Bars = p50/p95/p99 stacked. Line = cost.
jordan: Recommend a dashed fallback line indicating routing to cheaper variant when SLOs breach 1 99th percentile 1. frames the graceful degradation story.
liv: Headline options for slide/landing: "Latency vs Unit Economics: Real Production Benchmarks" OR "Slash Tail Latency, Protect Your Budget" 1 which resonates more?
alex: Second is punchier for ads. shorter works better in social creative.
sam: Data request: eng/runtime, can you export CSV with per-model p50/p95/p99 and cost_per_1k for hosted vs dedicated with cache_on true/false? benchbot: here's the run link: https://bench.internal/runs/175890/summary

benchbot: CSV attached in run 175890, models=[redwood-small, redwood-med, open-xl], fields=[p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,cache_on,deploy_type].

maria: Marketing deliverables: (1) Hero waterfall slide (PNG + editable fig file) (2) Social image static + 3 headline/copy variants for A/B testing + landing blurb. Also need signup routing: webinar signups -> SDR queue if company_size >= 200 or product_interest = Dedicated; otherwise to marketing nurture.
jordan: Routing logic: add a radio on the form: Hosted / Dedicated / Unsure. If Dedicated -> tag SDR. If Unsure + company_size >=200 -> SDR. else nurture. Keep it simple for ops.
liv: Social copy drafts:
- Variant A: "See how smart routing slashes tail latency 1 and cuts token costs. Live demo."
- Variant B: "Faster responses, lower bills: real-world benchmarks from Redwood Inference."
- Variant C: "Production latency vs price 1 pragmatic tradeoffs, live walkthrough."
Which is best for paid?
alex: A for paid (action-first), B for organic, C for webinar description.
sam: Slide mock specs for Figma (drop-in):
```
X labels: [redwood-small, redwood-med, open-xl]
Bars: p50=light blue, p95=teal, p99=navy (stacked)
Overlay: cost_per_1k (orange line, right axis)
Callouts: "Prefix caching -> ~2x lower cost", "Fallback to lightweight model for p99"
```

jordan: Add a tiny table/panel showing a monthly cost example for 10M tokens under each config so viewers see $$ impact. marketing loves concrete $ numbers.
maria: Timeline: need final assets by Wednesday EOD for Thursday morning invite send. Owners: sam = CSV + draft PNG, liv = copy + image variants, alex = landing + form routing, jordan = SDR mapping + CTA logic.
sam: I'll have CSV and Figma frame by Tuesday, PNG first pass by Tuesday EOD.
liv: I'll draft email subjects and 6 social lines by Wednesday morning and drop into #content-review.
alex: I'll wire up the landing form and routing tags; will ask for QA once it's live on staging.
maria: One-sentence explainer for landing under the chart: "We measured latency and unit cost across common configurations 1 see how batching, caching, and routing affect real-world economics." Use plain language.
jordan: Compliance asks for a small footnote: "Benchmarks run in a controlled environment; results may vary by workload." Put in small gray text.
liv: Please post final copy in #content-review when ready; I'll run approvals. :pray: 
maria: Great work, team. excited to get this into the webinar creative. :rocket:
